name: evidencecrew
description: EvidenceCrew - a local control plane for verifiable multi-agent work: DeepSeek plans, ChatGPT works, Codex reviews when you want it, Evidence proves what happened.
$comment_version: 0.1.0 is the PUBLIC version, and it is the only version number a user or an issue report should ever
see. Development happens under separate internal milestone numbers which are deliberately NOT named
here: a milestone number in a shipped file goes stale the moment the next milestone lands, and a reader
who quotes it in an issue is describing a tree that does not exist. docs/RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md and the
maintainer notes carry the internal numbering.
0.x is deliberate. The protocol, the Evidence Record shape and the seat registry are implemented and
tested, but they have not survived a second independent implementation, and calling that 1.0 would
$comment_dependencies: DELIBERATELY EMPTY, AND THIS IS A FEATURE.
The harness, the browser worker adapter and the workbench are all zero-dependency: Node built-in
modules only. That is why `npm install` finishes instantly and why the stack runs offline, on a
machine that cannot reach npm, and from a checkout on a USB stick.
It also means there is no lockfile to audit and no transitive dependency to trust. If you are
considering a change that adds a dependency, read CONTRIBUTING.md first: the answer is usually no, and
the reason is that this tool drives a logged-in browser session and writes to your project.
